item.title: postgresql: 13.20 -> 13.21, 14.17 -> 14.18, 15.12 -> 15.13, 16.8 -> 16.9, 17.4 -> 17.5
item.description:
The new minor releases have been "stamped", but not tagged, yet. Thus pointing at the commit hashes for now - the tags will appear later this week on the same, so it will be possible to change them without rebuilds.

Release notes are not published, yet, but available through git: https://github.com/postgres/postgres/blob/5e2f3df49d4298c6097789364a5a53be172f6e85/doc/src/sgml/release-17.sgml

There is one CVE:

While unlikely, a SIGSEGV crash could occur if an incomplete multibyte character appeared at the end of memory. This was possible both in the server and in libpq-using applications. (CVE-2025-4207)

Doesn't seem critical.
